verses.pali: “Dasahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṁ nikkhitto evaṁ niraye.
verses.english: “Someone with ten qualities is placed in hell as if delivered there.

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco pāṇātipātī hoti luddo lohitapāṇi hatapahate niviṭṭho adayāpanno sabbapāṇabhūtesu.
verses.english: It’s when a certain person kills living creatures. They’re violent, bloody-handed, a hardened killer, merciless to living beings.

verses.pali: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, dasahi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṁ nikkhitto evaṁ niraye.
verses.english: Someone with these ten qualities is placed in hell as if delivered there.

verses.pali: Dasahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṁ nikkhitto evaṁ sagge.
verses.english: Someone with ten qualities is placed in heaven as if delivered there.

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco pāṇātipātaṁ pahāya pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti nihitadaṇḍo nihitasattho lajjī dayāpanno, sabbapāṇabhūtahitānukampī viharati.
verses.english: It’s when a certain person gives up killing living creatures. They renounce the rod and the sword. They’re scrupulous and kind, living full of sympathy for all living beings.

verses.pali: pisuṇaṁ vācaṁ pahāya pisuṇāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti …
pharusaṁ vācaṁ pahāya pharusāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti …
‘atthi dinnaṁ …pe… ye imañca lokaṁ parañca lokaṁ sayaṁ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedentī’ti.
Imehi kho, bhikkhave, dasahi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṁ nikkhitto evaṁ sagge”ti.
verses.english: Someone with these ten qualities is placed in heaven as if delivered there.”
